name: claude-mem
install:
script=$(find . -maxdepth 4 \( -name node_modules -o -name .git \) -prune -o -path '*/.cursor/install.sh' -print -quit)
if [ -z "$script" ] && [ -f .cursor/install.sh ]; then script=.cursor/install.sh; fi
test -n "$script"
bash "$script"
start:
script=$(find . -maxdepth 4 \( -name node_modules -o -name .git \) -prune -o -path '*/.cursor/start.sh' -print -quit)
if [ -z "$script" ] && [ -f .cursor/start.sh ]; then script=.cursor/start.sh; fi
test -n "$script"
bash "$script"
